reason: The cited evidence does not address laser cladding, WC reinforcement, or the specific HEA system proposed. E1 concerns a different deposition method and HEA film without WC, while E2 reports on a thermally sprayed HEA coating without WC, showing adhesive wear and splat delamination. Neither supports the key premises about the proposed intervention's mechanism or performance.
premises: Laser cladding of HEA+WC yields a dense, well-adhered composite coating with refined microstructure and uniform WC distribution.
WC particles block crack propagation and distribute stresses, reducing wear.
The coating will achieve >30% increase in surface hardness over untreated baseline.
The coating will exhibit reduced wear and corrosion rates under aggressive conditions.
